release_notes:
- The "Find Full Text" queue now downloads PDFs in the background: Nexus SR stays responsive while it works, and pausing it stops the downloads straight away.
- The queue now also uses the PDF sources (Base URLs) you added in FFT Advanced.
- AI full-text screening reads the parts of each article that matter: the methods are always kept and the reference list is left out, with the same decisions as before.
- The AI cost shown before running PRISMA, CONSORT, CASP/JBI and Power is now lower, matching what is actually charged.
- Power analysis with AI no longer receives an empty article when the PDF is very long.
- Save buttons in Benchmark and Citation Chaser stay greyed out until there is something to save. In Chat with PDF, the button now says "Save as Word (.docx)".
- On Windows, if Nexus SR cannot start or install, the log now records the step that failed and the antivirus on the computer, so we can help you faster.
